_comment: Phase 2b golden: the useState reel as an INTERVIEW (shorts/motion_themes.yaml). Same 11 fix_story beats, story, objects and recap as usestate_golden.json; every caption carries its speaker, and each beat follows the interview beat template (who speaks, who opens). Only the INTERVIEWER asks. Also the stub answer for the interview theme on useState material (shorts/stubs.py).
topic: Why does changing a plain variable not update the screen?
hook_question: Why does this like counter stay stuck at zero?

shots.speech: Why does this like counter stay stuck at zero?

captions.text: Why does this like counter stay stuck at zero?
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

shots.visual: Interview desk: INTERVIEWER holds up a phone mock; each tap on the like button fails and the count stays 0; status pill 'Still 0'.

shots.speech: Because a plain variable can't remember between renders.

captions.text: Because a plain variable can't remember between renders.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: Title card: series label, 'useState', the promise line, three icon tiles; CANDIDATE avatar beside it.

shots.speech: Here's the code. Likes live in a plain variable, and each tap adds one. What's wrong with it?

captions.text: Here's the code.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: Likes live in a plain variable, and each tap adds one.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: What's wrong with it?
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

shots.visual: Code window LikeButton.jsx, two lines highlighted in turn; INTERVIEWER points.

shots.speech: On every re-render, React runs your component again from the top. The variable starts fresh, back to zero.

captions.text: On every re-render, React runs your component again from the top.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

captions.text: The variable starts fresh, back to zero.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: Entity card <LikeButton /> showing 1; a render sweep passes and the value drops back to 0.

shots.speech: Anything else? Changing a plain variable never tells React anything changed. So the screen never updates.

captions.text: Anything else?
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: Changing a plain variable never tells React anything changed.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

captions.text: So the screen never updates.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: Entity card above a system panel 'React: Idle'; the connector between them is broken with an x.

shots.speech: So what fixes it? use State. React keeps the value in its own memory. It hands it back on every render.

captions.text: So what fixes it?
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: useState.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

captions.text: React keeps the value in its own memory.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

captions.text: It hands it back on every render.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: System panel 'React' now holding a 'likes' slot; a pulse travels up the connector to the entity card.

shots.speech: And set Likes is the trigger. Call it, and React updates its memory, then re-renders with the new value.

captions.text: And setLikes is the trigger.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

captions.text: Call it, and React updates its memory, then re-renders with the new value.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: Trigger chip setLikes(1) sends a pulse to the system panel; the slot goes 0 to 1; the entity card re-renders showing 1.

shots.speech: Show me that in code. use State of zero gives you the value and its setter.

captions.text: Show me that in code.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: useState(0) gives you the value and its setter.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: Code map card: likes -> memory icon 'the current value'; setLikes -> bolt icon 'updates it and re-renders'.

shots.speech: Now every tap sticks, and your likes keep climbing.

captions.text: Now every tap sticks, and your likes keep climbing.
captions.speaker: CANDIDATE

shots.visual: The hook's phone mock again: each tap succeeds and the count climbs 1, 2, 3; status pill 'It works'.

shots.speech: Remember: re-renders reset plain variables. use State keeps the value. And the setter updates it and re-renders.

captions.text: Remember: re-renders reset plain variables.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: useState keeps the value.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

captions.text: And the setter updates it and re-renders.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

shots.visual: Takeaway list: three rows with the refresh, memory and bolt icons.

shots.speech: Follow for more, one idea at a time.

captions.text: Follow for more, one idea at a time.
captions.speaker: INTERVIEWER

shots.visual: End card: Up next, Follow button, series chips.
